programme.desc: Le prince Ivandoe se précipite dans le marécage brumeux pour trouver des navets, mais il rencontre la redoutable Dame des marais ; pendant ce temps, Bert est ensorcelé par la reine de la Brume, mais laquelle devrait-on craindre le plus ? (Animated, Children)

programme.desc: Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Pedro's Cough
programme.desc: Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children quickly catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - The Library
programme.desc: Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa's Compost Heap

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You - Blue's Treasure of Clue Lagoon

programme.title: The Adventures of Paddington
programme.desc: Jonathan and Judy can't agree on what to do in 'Paddington and the Big Decision', then in 'Paddington's Beach Stowaway', the Browns come back from a beach with more than sand in their hair. (Children)

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Baby Smurf travels through time in 'Smurfily Gmurfy', and in 'Smurf T for Thief', someone has stolen the Blue Moon festival cake, and to find the culprit, Chef has to lead an investigation. (Children)

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Queen Thistle's Day Off

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Nature Class
programme.desc: Nanny Plum takes the Fairy children for a nature class in the woods, and bumps into the Wise Old Elf who is teaching a nature class to the Elf children. (Action & Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids) - 2025

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Richard Rabbit Comes To Play
programme.desc: Richard Rabbit comes to play with George, while Suzy Sheep comes to play with Peppa. The little boys don't want to play the same games as Peppa and Suzy. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Washing
programme.desc: Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in, which makes Daddy's shirt pink. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Polly's Boat Trip
programme.desc: Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send for help when their boat runs aground. Polly Parrot fetches Granny Pig and Granddad Dog, who rescues them. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Delphine Donkey
programme.desc: Peppa's French friend Delphine Donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - The Fire Engine
programme.desc: Peppa and George go with Mummy Pig to Miss Rabbit's Mummies Fire Engine Service. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Princess Peppa
programme.desc: Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig, but Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed, until they are told a story. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Teddy Playgroup
programme.desc: Peppa brings home a teddy from Playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he won't have a very exciting time. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Danny's Pirate Party
programme.desc: It's Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig, the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Toy Robot
programme.desc: Out playing in the meadow, Holly, Ben and their friends find a broken toy robot. Holly fixes it with magic, but the robot does not behave as they thought it would. (Action & Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids) - 2025

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Big Bad Barry
programme.desc: King Thistle wants fish for dinner, so he goes out fishing with Mr Elf, Ben and Holly on Mr Elf's boat. Mr Elf tells them a story about the biggest, baddest fish ever - Big Bad Barry. (Action & Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids) - 2025

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - King Thistle's Birthday
programme.desc: King Thistle does not want to get any older so decides that no one must celebrate his birthday. But all of the Little Kingdom has been waiting to celebrate. (Action & Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids) - 2025

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - The Wand Factory
programme.desc: Holly breaks her wand and must go to the Wand Factory, at the bottom of the Great Elf Tree, to get it fixed. (Action & Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids) - 2025

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse - Fairy Festival
programme.desc: 5.4.3.2.1. It's fairy o'clock - and the start of a fantastic festival, featuring rides, games, cotton candy and a new friend with a flower contest dream. (Animation, Comedy, Kids, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Children) - 2021

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Potato Comes To Town
programme.desc: All of Peppa's town are excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre in town. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - The Train Ride
programme.desc: Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride, where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Pig's Chickens
programme.desc: Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her chickens, whilst something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Talent Day
programme.desc: It is Talent Day at Peppa's playgroup, and Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - A Trip To The Moon
programme.desc: Peppa's family go to the museum's Moon Exhibition with George's friend Edmond Elephant. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa At The Playground
programme.desc: Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Goldie The Fish
programme.desc: Goldie the Fish does not look happy and isn't eating her food, so Peppa, George and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the Vet. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Numbers
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends learn how to count through playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Humdinger puts on a cat costume and is mistaken for a real kitty in 'Pups Save the Space Kitties', then in 'Pups Save the Sea Sponges', after a deep-sea dive, Zuma dozes off and dreams. (Children)

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Chickaletta takes flight on a toy plane in 'Pups Save a High-Flying Hen', then in 'Pups Save a Sloth', Mayor Humdinger mistakes a sloth for a monkey, and races the Paw Patrol to find it. (Children)

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Camping Out
programme.desc: Holly is going on a camping trip with Ben and his mum and dad, but they are soon joined by annoying Mr Gnome, who is always hungry and sings silly songs. (Action & Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids) - 2025

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Dinner Party
programme.desc: Snooty King and Queen Marigold invite themselves round for dinner to King and Queen Thistle's castle to sample Nanny Plum's cooking. Nanny tries hard to cook special modern food. (Action & Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids) - 2025

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Woodpecker
programme.desc: King Thistle is bored and takes up the hobby of bird watching. Using his magic bird book, the King is pleased when another creature makes a nest in the Royal Castle. (Action & Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids) - 2025

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Daisy and Poppy's Pet
programme.desc: The Twins really want a pet and Nanny Plum sets about getting them one. She magics them up Pippin the hamster. The Wise Old Elf even brings Pippin a hamster wheel. (Action & Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family, Kids) - 2025

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Digging Up The Road
programme.desc: Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull and his team are digging up the road. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Freddy Fox
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it's Freddy Fox with his super smelling nose who is the best at playing that game. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Whistling
programme.desc: Peppa hears Daddy Pig making a strange sound. It's called whistling, but when Peppa tries, she discovers that it is quite impossible - at first. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Doctor Hamster's Tortoise
programme.desc: Doctor Hamster visits the school and brings some animals with her. Binky the tortoise is very popular - but ends up needing to be rescued by Miss Rabbit. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Sun, Sea and Snow
programme.desc: It's a lovely day to visit the beach - or it would be, if it wasn't snowing. Miss Rabbit's snow plough saves the day. Mummy Pig goes for a swim, but finds it colder than expected. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa Pig's Computer
programme.desc: Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work - as well as Happy Mrs Chicken. But who will fix it when it breaks. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Hospital
programme.desc: Pedro Pony is in hospital with a broken leg! The class come to see him. Pedro is being well looked-after - there's always someone to scratch behind your ears. And soon his leg is all better. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Miss Rabbit's Helicopter
programme.desc: Miss Rabbit gives Mummy Pig, Peppa and George a ride in her rescue helicopter. Daddy Pig is very sad to escape all the fun - but Miss Rabbit makes sure that doesn't happen. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: The Adventures of Paddington
programme.desc: It's the Windsor Gardens pet show in 'Paddington becomes a Talent Show Judge', and in 'Paddington Keeps Up With The Kamalis', playing with neighbours is more fun than trying to outdo them. (Children)

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Mayor Humdinger babysits in 'Pups Save the Kitties and the Kiddies', then in 'Pups Save the Green House', Mayor Goodway and Mayor Humdinger get locked in a greenhouse and need a rescue. (Children)

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Mayor Humdinger's robotic soccer cleats wreck the town in 'Pups Save a Hum-Kicker', then in 'Pups Save the One-Man Band', Francois causes musical mayhem. (Children)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Baby Alexander

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit's Lighthouse

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Miss Rabbit's Day Off

programme.title: Peppa Pig - The Secret Club
programme.desc: Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club - going on secret missions, and doing secret things. In secret. But soon everyone wants to join. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Shake, Rattle and Bang

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Champion Daddy Pig
